messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 10(9)

Article 10 Obligations of manufacturers of machinery and related products. 9. Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product, which they have placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate. Furthermore, where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, and, where appropriate, domestic animals or to property, and, where applicable, to the environment, manufacturers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the machinery or related product available on the market, or in which they put it into service, to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken.

response.text:
Manufacturers | shall take | corrective actions necessary to bring machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it | manufacturer considers or has reason to believe the product placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity; "as appropriate" | "shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate"
Manufacturers | shall immediately inform | competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the product available or put it into service | machinery or related product presents a risk to health or safety of persons, and where appropriate domestic animals or property, and where applicable the environment | "where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, and, where appropriate, domestic animals or to property, and, where applicable, to the environment, manufacturers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities"
Manufacturers | shall give details to competent national authorities | details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken | when informing authorities of a risk under Article 10(9) | "giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken"
